name: ami-worker
description: Ami tenant concierge — Cloudflare Worker and D1

scripts.db:seed: npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler d1 execute ami-db --local --file seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:concierge: npm run db:seed && wrangler d1 execute ami-db --local --file seed-concierge.sql
scripts.db:seed:demo: npm run db:seed:concierge && wrangler d1 execute ami-db --local --file seed-demo.sql && npm run db:seed:bills
scripts.db:seed:demo:remote: npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler d1 execute ami-db --remote --file seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute ami-db --remote --file seed-concierge.sql && wrangler d1 execute ami-db --remote --file seed-demo.sql && npm run db:seed:bills:remote
